{{Youmay|a title|a group of [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] known as the [[Directors]] or the [[:Category:Directors|directors]] of various ''Star Wars'' productions}}

[[File:YsanneIsard.jpg|thumb|200px|Director of Imperial Intelligence, Ysanne Isard]]
'''Director''' was a title used by the heads of certain government bureaus, private organizations, and other associations. It was used by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One of the most famous holders of the title was the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], [[Ysanne Isard]]. The [[Outbound Flight Colony]] was also headed by a Director.
